description: This Go source file implements a Kubernetes controller for managing a ConfigMap containing the root CA certificate in each namespace, ensuring its presence and correctness.

classes.name: Publisher
classes.description: A controller that manages ConfigMaps containing the root CA certificate in each namespace.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller's worker routines and manages shutdown.

methods.name: configMapDeleted
methods.description: Handles deletion events for ConfigMaps, enqueuing the namespace if relevant.

methods.name: configMapUpdated
methods.description: Handles update events for ConfigMaps, enqueuing the namespace if relevant.

methods.name: namespaceAdded
methods.description: Handles addition of new namespaces, enqueuing them for processing.

methods.name: namespaceUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to namespaces, enqueuing active ones.

methods.name: runWorker
methods.description: Processes items from the work queue.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Processes a single item from the queue, handling errors and retries.

methods.name: syncNamespace
methods.description: Ensures the ConfigMap with the root CA exists and is up-to-date in the specified namespace.

methods.name: convertToCM
methods.description: Converts a generic object to a ConfigMap, handling tombstones.
